candidates.specific_content: Draw four ranks: bottom 123; rank one 213=a and 132=b; rank two 231=ab and 312=ba; top 321. Ensure there are no same-rank edges; highlight 213≤231 while its inversion set {(1,2)} is not contained in {(1,3),(2,3)}.
